game.title: Ninja Gaiden 4
game.blurb: Hack-and-slash ninja action game from Team NINJA and PlatinumGames (RAWG lists Platinum Games, Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA), released 2025-10-21. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story, chapter by chapter, and its bosses. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Chapter Challenges
chapters.summary: Clearing set chapters without falling, hitting obstacles or touching lasers (Auto Movement off), and clearing a chapter without dying.

chapters.title: Missions, Trials and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Missions, the Purgatory trials, Gourdy critters, NinjaCoin and items.

chapters.title: Weapons and Skills
chapters.summary: Special moves with Takeminakata, Yatousen, Magatsuhi and Kage-Hiruko, and learning every weapon and combat skill.

chapters.title: Combat Basics
chapters.summary: Obliterations, Bloodraven Form, Bloodbath kills, Ultimate Techniques and big combos.

chapters.title: Master Ninja and Full Completion
chapters.summary: Finishing on MASTER NINJA difficulty and unlocking every achievement.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2627260)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (ninjagaiden.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://ninjagaiden.fandom.com/wiki/Ninja_Gaiden_4
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page under "Ninja Gaiden 4" or "Ninja Gaiden IV". ninjagaiden.fandom.com answers the API, with about 55 linked pages, including "Abyssal Road", "Trials", "Sky City Tokyo" and "Yakumo"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "TORO" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2627260 as "NINJA GAIDEN 4". 24 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions, so they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Some of them look like other content: "Raven Gear: Caddis Wire", "Dragonfly Glider" and "Pond Strider" (6 to 8) sound like traversal gear, "Ninja Fortitude" (18) sits next to the MASTER NINJA achievement, and the last nine (45 to 53, for example "Challenger of Challenges", "Ultimate Challenge" and "Conqueror of the Abyss", each unlocked by 2 to 11 percent of players) may be post-game or extra content, but nothing in the data says which. RAWG also has a separate "Ninja Gaiden IV" entry (2023) that is not this game; the expected entry (id 996616) was used.
